steps.title: Extrude the bar
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as beam_tube.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the YZ Plane. Circle diameter 50 on the origin. Finish Sketch.
Extrude 1540 mm along X. Click OK.
steps.note: The origin is the left end of the tube, on its axis.

steps.title: Make it a tube
actions: Click Hole. Placement: Concentric, on the end face. Diameter 47, Termination Through All. Click OK.
Material: Aluminum 7075-T6 (add it in the Material Browser if needed). Save.
steps.note: A 1.5 mm wall: the tube weighs 0.64 kg a metre. Beams are bought as recycled aluminium tube.
